reviewed_extensions.scope: Service deploy role read-only bake-gate grants; CloudWatch alarm ARNs in colon form; worker metric-filter grants on the CloudFormation execution role
reviewed_extensions.detail: Service deploy role: cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics; cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms on arn:aws:cloudwatch:ap-east-1:650880818323:alarm:beta-anywear-*; ecs:DescribeServices on the two workload services; sqs:GetQueueAttributes on beta-anywear-vto, beta-anywear-vto-dlq, beta-anywear-auto-tagging and beta-anywear-auto-tagging-dlq; logs:FilterLogEvents on /anywear/beta/worker. CloudFormation execution role: the pre-existing CloudWatch alarm grant uses the same colon alarm ARN, and the worker log group gains logs:PutMetricFilter, logs:DescribeMetricFilters and logs:DeleteMetricFilter for the outbox metric filter (worker log group only; no filter exists on the api log group). No SQS send/receive grant, no new resource family and no other widening. CloudWatch alarm ARNs are alarm:<AlarmName>, never alarm/<AlarmName>.
